results.name: buy_dip_200ma
results.thesis: Panic dip inside a healthy uptrend: stock drops >10% in a day but stays above its 200-day MA.

results.name: 52w_low_bounce
results.thesis: Contrarian bounce off maximum pessimism: stock within 3% of its 52-week low.

results.name: rsi_oversold
results.thesis: Classic oversold bounce: RSI(14) drops below 30.

results.name: macd_bull_cross
results.thesis: Early-stage momentum shift: MACD bullish crossover while still below zero. Replaced bb_lower_touch on 2026-07-12 after it failed the train/test cheat-check on rerun.

results.name: rsi_oversold_tight
results.thesis: SPY is in a low-vol grind (12.4% annualized 1-month vol, +0.3% 1mo / +3.9% 3mo). A tighter RSI threshold and shorter period should still find real oversold spikes without over-triggering on normal noise; short hold since moves are smaller right now.

results.name: inside_day_breakout_default
results.thesis: Inside-day contraction followed by a breakout is a volatility-contraction signal that should show up more often in the current low-vol tape than in choppier regimes, with cleaner follow-through.

results.name: bb_lower_touch_tight
results.thesis: With realized vol this low, the default 2.0-std lower band rarely gets touched. Tightening to 1.5 std should generate enough real mean-reversion signals; short hold to capture the quick snapback.

results.name: bb_lower_touch_wide
results.thesis: A wider window and stricter 2.5-std band is a higher-conviction extreme-deviation signal for when the market does have a real drawdown; longer hold to let a bigger reversion play out.

results.name: bb_squeeze_breakout_default
results.thesis: Low realized vol means Bollinger squeezes are common right now. A breakout from a squeeze inside a mild 3-month uptrend should have decent follow-through rather than reverting immediately.

results.name: macd_bull_cross_fast
results.thesis: A faster MACD pair should catch momentum shifts sooner in a low-vol grind, where the incumbent 12/26/9 cross can be slow to trigger on subtle moves.

results.name: buy_dip_ma_shallow
results.thesis: The incumbent's 10% single-day drop threshold will be rare at 12.4% annualized vol. Lowering to 6% with a shorter 150-day MA trend filter should actually generate signals while still requiring a real uptrend.

results.name: buy_dip_ma_long_ma
results.thesis: Same shallow-dip logic, but filtered by the full 1-year MA for a stricter 'still in a real uptrend' check before buying the dip.

results.name: low_52w_bounce_tight
results.thesis: Tighter proximity to the 52-week low is a higher-conviction capitulation signal than the incumbent's 3% band; long hold since these are slow-grinding reversals, not quick bounces.

results.name: three_red_days_quick
results.thesis: In a calm, mildly-up tape, even two consecutive red days stands out more than usual. Short hold to capture the immediate mean-reversion bounce.

results.name: failed_breakout_short_default
results.thesis: In a low-vol tape, genuine breakouts should hold; ones that fail immediately on weak volume are a cleaner exhaustion signal than usual. Short hold to capture the quick reversal down.

results.name: high_volume_hammer_lowvol
results.thesis: Lowering the drop threshold to fit current low volatility, while still requiring above-average volume and a strong intraday recovery off the lows as real reversal confirmation.

results.name: golden_cross_classic
results.thesis: Classic trend-following entry. The market's already in a mild 3-month uptrend with low vol, so a fresh golden cross should have follow-through with less whipsaw risk than in a choppier tape.

results.name: death_cross_short_classic
results.thesis: A hedge/diversifier on the short side: even with SPY in a mild uptrend, individual names breaking their own long-term trend via a fresh death cross are worth testing as a counter-trend risk-off signal.

results.name: n_day_breakout_20
results.thesis: 20-day high breakouts in a low-vol grind-up market should be cleaner (less noise, less immediate fade) with steadier follow-through than in a high-vol regime.

results.name: gap_down_recovery_default
results.thesis: An intraday reversal of a gap-down is a quick mean-reversion play; short hold to capture just the snapback, not a longer trend.

results.name: gap_up_continuation_default
results.thesis: In a mild uptrend, gap-ups that hold and close green often continue short-term as a momentum-continuation play.

results.name: relative_strength_spy_default
results.thesis: Names meaningfully outperforming SPY's +3.9% 3-month return show real relative strength worth riding, rather than betting on mean reversion in a market that isn't stretched.

results.name: turn_of_month_default
results.thesis: Well-documented turn-of-month seasonal drift is regime-independent, so it's a useful diversifier regardless of the current low-vol backdrop. Short hold to capture just the effect window.

results.name: capitulation_exhaustion_lowvol
results.thesis: Lowering the cumulative-return threshold to fit current low realized vol, so a 7% pullback on below-average volume (exhaustion, not panic) still counts as capitulation above the 200-day MA.
